title: AiVision Observability Plugin Configuration
description: Unified production configuration schema for observ-openclaw, observ-opencode, observ-pi, and observ-hermes. Transcript capture, offline replay, and local replay artifact paths are outside this production configuration schema.

enableTelemetry.description: Master switch for telemetry collection. When false, no traces/metrics/events are exported.

serviceName.description: OpenTelemetry service.name resource attribute. Plugin defaults are openclaw, opencode, and pi respectively.

collectionMode.description: Content collection mode. 'full' records configured telemetry content (prompts, outputs, tool I/O). 'privacy' redacts content-bearing production telemetry.

debug.description: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. This does not enable transcript capture or offline replay.

dynamicUsername.description: When enabled, resolve ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded. Falls back to otelExporter.attributes.ant.username when the environment variable is empty.

dynamicUid.description: When enabled, resolve ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded. Falls back to otelExporter.attributes.ant.uid when the environment variable is empty.

otelExporter.description: OTel exporter configuration. Controls the global OTLP export settings.

endpoint.description: Base OTLP endpoint URL. Falls back into per-signal configs when signal-specific endpoints are not set.

headers.description: Global OTLP request headers. Merged with per-signal headers (per-signal takes precedence).

attributes.description: Common attributes injected into every span, event/log, and metric. Configure ant.username and signal-scoped ant.uid here.

ant.meta.trigger.description: External task attribution for the process Resource. This value is supplied by deployment configuration and is not inferred from transcripts. AIVISION_META_TRIGGER overrides all resource attribute layers; absent input emits an empty Resource value, while explicit empty or invalid runtime values normalize to unknown.

resourceAttributes.description: Resource attributes, including ant.agent.* metadata and optional ant.meta.trigger task attribution. ant.uid is signal-only and is removed from Resource.
resourceAttributes.x-env-merge-order: config < OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES < AIVISION_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES < OBSERV_{PLUGIN}_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES < AIVISION_META_TRIGGER (ant.meta.trigger only)

metricsTemporalityPreference.description: Metrics temporality preference for the OTLP exporter.

tracesConfig.description: Trace-specific OTLP endpoint and header overrides.

metricsConfig.description: Metrics-specific OTLP endpoint and header overrides.

eventsConfig.description: Events/Logs-specific OTLP endpoint and header overrides.

logDir.description: Directory for the plugin-owned diagnostic log file. If omitted, common editions use their runtime log directory and AIVision editions use ~/.aivision/ocw, ~/.aivision/ocd, ~/.aivision/pi, or ~/.aivision/hermes as the product-specific root. Diagnostic logging never enables replay capture.

SignalEndpointConfig.description: Per-signal OTLP endpoint configuration. Overrides the global otelExporter settings for a specific signal (traces/metrics/events).

endpoint.description: Signal-specific OTLP endpoint URL. When not set, falls back to otelExporter.endpoint.

headers.description: Signal-specific request headers. Merged on top of global otelExporter.headers.

ContentLoggingConfig.description: Internal content logging switches derived from collectionMode. Not a public configuration surface — controlled entirely by collectionMode.

ContentLoggingSwitches.description: Per-signal-type content logging switches. All switches are derived from collectionMode: full=all true, privacy=all false.

toolDetails.description: Record tool call parameters and MCP/Skill names.

x-env-var-pattern.plugin-specific: OBSERV_{PLUGIN}_* — plugin-specific overrides (OBSERV_OPENCLAW_*, OBSERV_OPENCODE_*, OBSERV_PI_*, OBSERV_HERMES_*)
x-env-var-pattern.priority: plugin-specific > standard > shared > config > edition > default

x-local-replay-tooling.description: Local transcript, replay artifact paths, offline replay, and report configuration is owned by the separate replay plugin.

pi.note: pireplay independently owns explicit developer raw capture and offline replay; observ-pi production configuration cannot enable or redirect it.

hermes.note: hermes-replay independently owns explicit developer raw capture, offline replay, and loopback-only reporting; observ-hermes production configuration cannot enable or redirect it.

order: 2. Environment variable (shared AIVISION_* or standard OTEL_*)
